create.name: Wendy Chan
create.bio:
Wendy Chan is a Singapore yoga and meditation teacher and the founder of Yoga Seeds, a small shala set in the greenery of Bishan Park. An early interest in philosophy, both Eastern and Western, drew her into the study of the mind and the body's subtle energies, and from there to yoga and meditation, which she has trained in across several traditions. She is registered as an E-RYT 500 and a continuing-education provider with Yoga Alliance, and she leads the studio's teaching team and its teacher-training faculty, writing the curriculum herself.

Her own classes mix classical hatha, vinyasa and yin, with the breath as the thread through both movement and stillness. Beyond the weekly timetable she runs Yoga Alliance-accredited 200-hour trainings over eight weekends, introductory philosophy weekends built around the Gita and Patanjali's sutras, and retreats and workshops in Singapore and around Asia. Service is part of how she frames the practice: she is an ambassador for the charity Yoga Gives Back and runs Yoga Seeds' karma yoga projects, including pay-what-you-wish community classes. Outside the studio she dives and hikes, and much of her teaching draws on time spent in nature.

courses.title: The Heart of Yoga - An Introduction to Yoga Philosophy
courses.description: A two-day weekend with Wendy at the Bishan Park shala, reading the Bhagavad Gita and the Yoga Sutras and asking how they apply to everyday life. Each day mixes hatha practice, pranayama, meditation, storytelling and discussion; no background in philosophy is needed.

courses.title: 200hr Yoga Teacher Training, Mar 2027 Intake
courses.description: Yoga Seeds' Yoga Alliance-accredited foundation training, held over eight weekends at the shala, with Wendy as lead trainer. It covers asana, pranayama, meditation and kriyas, teaching method, anatomy, and the Yoga Sutras and Gita, and trainees can join studio classes free while it runs.

courses.title: 200hr Yoga Teacher Training, July 2027 Intake
courses.description: The mid-year run of the same eight-weekend foundation training, led by the Yoga Seeds faculty under Wendy. Suits practitioners who want to deepen their own practice as well as those who mean to teach.

free_resources.title: Yoga & Tea: A 200hr & 300hr YTT Discovery Session with Wendy Chan
free_resources.description: A free Sunday morning hour at the shala: a 45-minute breath-led class taught by Wendy, then tea and an open conversation about the studio's training pathways. Open to anyone curious, whether or not they plan to teach.
